macros.name: doman
macros.doc: The macros \Doman and \doman are equivalent to \Roman and \roman, giving either capitalized or lowercase dozenal Roman numerals.

macros.name: doznumtoword
macros.doc: dozenal allows you to easily convert counters into words, by supplying said counter’s name to the \doznumtoword macro.

macros.name: dozrankoneword
macros.doc: The rank words (“unqua,” “biqua,” and so forth) are all customizable by userlevel commands, which are named \dozrankoneword for “unqua,” \dozranktwoword for “biqua,” and so forth.

macros.doc: \x and \e are the commands used to quickly and easily access the symbols for ten and eleven.
